news.title: Midtown attack victim says threatening voicemail has her fearing for her safety
news.summary: The woman who says she was attacked in broad daylight in Midtown says the ordeal has continued to weigh on her, even after the suspect was arrested.

news.title: Family mourns loss of man killed outside his workplace in Atlanta
news.summary: The family of a man shot and killed outside his southeast Atlanta workplace is mourning and searching for answers after police arrested a suspect in the fatal shooting.

news.title: 2 dead after being trapped inside house fire
news.summary: A fire broke out at a home in SW Atlanta Wednesday evening.

news.title: Woman, boy killed in Atlanta house fire, officials say
news.summary: A woman and a boy were killed in a house fire on Waters Road on Wednesday night, according to the Atlanta Fire Rescue Department.

news.title: Clayton police release rendering to help identify human remains
news.summary: Clayton County police are asking for the community's help to identify a man after human remains were recovered in the area.

news.title: DeKalb police searching for man accused in series of ATV thefts
news.summary: DeKalb County police are asking for the public's help locating a man wanted in connection with a series of ATV thefts involving social media meetups.

news.title: Fayetteville Target evacuated after phone sale ends in attempted theft
news.summary: A Target store in Fayetteville was evacuated Wednesday afternoon after a phone sale went awry and led to a chase into the building, according to police.

news.title: Atlanta police launch 15 new e-bikes along Beltline trail
news.summary: Atlanta Police are rolling out a fleet of 15 new e-bikes along the Beltline this weekend to help decrease emergency response times and make long patrol shifts easier on officers.

news.title: Police seek help finding suspect in ATV theft cases
news.summary: DeKalb County Police say Jordan Wright is wanted on three theft by taking counts after ATV meetup thefts arranged through social media.

news.title: Metro Atlanta Target evacuated after cell phone sale dispute
news.summary: A dispute at a metro Atlanta Target led to a heavy police presence and one man in handcuffs, according to police.

news.title: FBI Atlanta increases reward for suspect wanted for kidnapping, extortion
news.summary: According to the agency, Julious George Khalid and others portrayed themselves as law enforcement and stopped a victim at gunpoint on I-20 near Panola Road.

news.title: Former DeKalb police sergeant indicted in 15-year-old rape, kidnapping cold case
news.summary: Local and federal authorities are scheduled to reveal an indictment in a long-unsolved 2011 DeKalb County investigation.

news.title: Investigation into suspected cocaine trafficking from Acworth home leads to 4 arrests
news.summary: The Cherokee Multi-Agency Narcotics Squad (CMANS) received information that residents inside a home on Valley Farm Lane were allegedly trafficking cocaine.

news.title: Conyers counseling center owner accused of billing Medicaid under a dead psychiatrist’s credentials
news.summary: A Conyers counseling center owner faces felony charges for allegedly billing Georgia Medicaid using a deceased psychiatrist's credentials.

news.title: Second arrest made in Vine City shooting that killed former football player
news.summary: Chance Blue faces murder, robbery, and assault charges in a targeted shooting that killed former Georgia State athlete Demazio Skelton Jr.

news.title: Suspect in custody after fight at Quality Inn in Fayetteville turned deadly
news.summary: Anyone with information regarding this incident is asked to contact Corporal Brandao at sbrandao@fayetteville-ga.gov.
